title: S3C-LLM: Skill-Code Guided Agentic Language Models for Spectrum-to-Structure Elucidation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30910v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spectroscopic structure elucidation is central to molecular analysis, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods mostly formulate it as direct spectrum-to-SMILES generation. Although this paradigm can leverage paired spectral data, it does not explicitly model the analytical workflow used by spectroscopists, such as diagnostic peak interpretation, fragment reasoning, formula constraints, and chemical consistency checking. In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation. Rather than directly predicting a molecule, S3C-LLM retrieves modality-specific spectroscopy skills, executes analysis code to instantiate these skills on the input spectra, and integrates the resulting peak-level evidence and formula constraints before generating SMILES. Specifically, we contribute a self-evolving spectroscopy skill library, a thinking-augmented skill-code trajectory const

translated_title: S3C-LLM：面向光谱到结构解析的技能-代码引导的智能体语言模型
translated_abstract: 光谱结构解析是分子分析的核心，但近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法大多将其表述为从光谱直接生成SMILES的任务。尽管这一范式可以利用成对的光谱数据，但它并未显式建模光谱学家所使用的分析工作流程，例如诊断峰解读、片段推理、分子式约束以及化学一致性检查。本文提出了S3C-LLM，一种技能引导且以代码为基础的智能体大语言模型，用于从光谱到结构的解析。S3C-LLM并非直接预测分子，而是检索特定模态的光谱学技能，执行分析代码以在输入光谱上实例化这些技能，并在生成SMILES之前整合由此得到的峰级证据与分子式约束。具体而言，我们贡献了一个可自我进化的光谱学技能库，以及一个思维增强的技能-代码轨迹构造方法（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出S3C-LLM，一个技能引导、代码驱动的智能体大语言模型，通过检索光谱学技能、执行分析代码提取峰级证据与分子式约束后再生成SMILES，从而显式模拟光谱学家的分析工作流程，实现从光谱到分子结构的解析。
en_tdlr: S3C-LLM is a skill-guided, code-grounded agentic LLM that mimics spectroscopists' analytical workflow by retrieving modality-specific spectroscopy skills, executing analysis code to extract peak-level evidence and formula constraints, and then generating molecular structures from spectra.
